case_name: State of Uttar Pradesh v Munesh
respondent:
Munesh
Supreme Court of India

12 October 2012
Cr.A. No. 180 of 2007
The Judgment was delivered by : P. Sathasivam, J.
1.  This appeal is filed by the State of U.P. against the final judgment and order dated 16.10.2003 passed by the High Court of Judicature at Allahabad in Criminal Appeal No. 737 of 2003 whereby the High Court allowed the appeal filed by the respondent herein and acquitted him of the offences punishable u/ss. 302 and 376 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 (hereinafter referred to as "IPC") and set aside the judgment and order dated 15.02.2003 passed by the Additional Sessions Judge/Special Judge (E.C. Act), Bulandshahar in Sessions Case No. 748 of 2002.
Prosecution case in a nutshell is as follows:
(a) On 05.03.2002, at about 04.30 p.m., Roshni (the deceased), aged about 11 years, had gone alone from her house in Kalander Garhi, PS Khurja Nagar, Bulandshahar, U.P. to prepare cow-dung cakes in the cremation ground of Jatavs' and while she was doing
holding: The accused has first committed the offence of rape and then murdered the deceased.
The prosecution has established both the charges u/ss. 376 and 302 of IPC.

The respondent-accused is directed to surrender before the concerned authority/Court within a period of two weeks failing which the trial Judge is directed to take necessary effective steps for sending him to prison.
